about: fathers#150: the review role of Mastack's models.toml, stand-in weekly Codex limit answers (percent used, rateLimitReachedType), the implementer's family and the reviewer each case must give. Lanefather's own choice (no bin/role) and Mastack's bin/role read the same cases, so the two cannot drift; Mastack's tests are to read this file too.
table:
schema = 1
[models.opus]
id = "claude-opus-5-5"
family = "anthropic"
cli = "claude"
[models.sol]
id = "gpt-6.1-sol"
family = "openai"
cli = "codex"
[roles.review]
choices = [
  { model = "sol", effort = "medium", when = { not_family = true, limit = { codex_weekly = 15 } } },
  { model = "opus", effort = "medium", when = { not_family = true } },
  { model = "opus", effort = "medium", note = "same family as the implementer: fresh context only" },
]

cases.name: an OpenAI implementer gets the other family
